# CM IV · Position of the Communists in Relation to the Various Existing Opposition Parties

*Stellung der Kommunisten zu den verschiedenen oppositionellen Parteien*

Original: MEW 4, S. 459-493 (Dietz, Berlin), text of the 1890 German edition, the last edited by Engels, via mlwerke.de; 1848/1872/1883/1888 variants from MEW's apparatus  
English: Samuel Moore and Friedrich Engels, English edition of 1888; Marxists Internet Archive transcription proofed against the 1888 edition by Andy Blunden (2004), CC BY-SA

| Verse | German (MEW, 1890 text) | English 1888 (Moore and Engels) | Modern draft | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="IV.0.1"></a>**IV.0.1** | IV. Stellung der Kommunisten zu den verschiedenen oppositionellen Parteien | IV. Position of the Communists in Relation to the Various Existing Opposition Parties | IV. The Position of the Communists Toward the Various Existing Opposition Parties |  |
| <a id="IV.1.1"></a>**IV.1.1** | Nach Abschnitt II versteht sich das Verhältnis der Kommunisten zu den bereits konstituierten Arbeiterparteien von selbst, also ihr Verhältnis zu den Chartisten in England und den agrarischen Reformern in Nordamerika. | Section II has made clear the relations of the Communists to the existing working-class parties, such as the Chartists in England and the Agrarian Reformers in America. | Section II made clear the relationship of the communists to the existing working-class parties, such as the Chartists in England and the Agrarian Reformers in America. |  |
| <a id="IV.2.1"></a>**IV.2.1** | Sie kämpfen für die Erreichung der unmittelbar vorliegenden Zwecke und Interessen der Arbeiterklasse, aber sie vertreten in der gegenwärtigen Bewegung zugleich die Zukunft der Bewegung. | The Communists fight for the attainment of the immediate aims, for the enforcement of the momentary interests of the working class; but in the movement of the present, they also represent and take care of the future of that movement. | The communists fight for the immediate aims, for the short-term interests of the working class. But inside the movement of the present, they also represent and take care of the future of that movement. |  |
| <a id="IV.2.2"></a>**IV.2.2** | In Frankreich schließen sich die Kommunisten an die sozial-demokratische Partei an gegen die konservative und radikale Bourgeoisie, ohne darum das Recht aufzugeben, sich kritisch zu den aus der revolutionären Überlieferung herrührenden Phrasen und Illusionen zu verhalten. | In France, the Communists ally with the Social-Democrats against the conservative and radical bourgeoisie, reserving, however, the right to take up a critical position in regard to phases and illusions traditionally handed down from the great Revolution. | In France, the communists ally with the Social Democrats against the conservative and radical bourgeoisie - while reserving the right to take a critical position toward phrases and illusions handed down from the great Revolution. | Author notes: N8 |
| <a id="IV.3.1"></a>**IV.3.1** | In der Schweiz unterstützen sie die Radikalen, ohne zu verkennen, daß diese Partei aus widersprechenden Elementen besteht, teils aus demokratischen Sozialisten im französischen Sinn, teils aus radikalen Bourgeois. | In Switzerland, they support the Radicals, without losing sight of the fact that this party consists of antagonistic elements, partly of Democratic Socialists, in the French sense, partly of radical bourgeois. | In Switzerland they support the Radicals, without losing sight of the fact that this party contains antagonistic elements - partly Democratic Socialists in the French sense, partly radical bourgeois. |  |
| <a id="IV.4.1"></a>**IV.4.1** | Unter den Polen unterstützen die Kommunisten die Partei, welche eine agrarische Revolution zur Bedingung der nationalen Befreiung macht, dieselbe Partei, welche die Krakauer Insurrektion von 1846 ins Leben rief. | In Poland, they support the party that insists on an agrarian revolution as the prime condition for national emancipation, that party which fomented the insurrection of Cracow in 1846. | In Poland they support the party that insists on an agrarian revolution as the first condition of national emancipation - the party that stirred up the Cracow insurrection of 1846. |  |
| <a id="IV.5.1"></a>**IV.5.1** | In Deutschland kämpft die Kommunistische Partei, sobald die Bourgeoisie revolutionär auftritt, gemeinsam mit der Bourgeoisie gegen die absolute Monarchie, das feudale Grundeigentum und die Kleinbürgerei. | In Germany, they fight with the bourgeoisie whenever it acts in a revolutionary way, against the absolute monarchy, the feudal squirearchy, and the petty bourgeoisie. | In Germany they fight alongside the bourgeoisie whenever it acts in a revolutionary way, against absolute monarchy, the feudal landed gentry, and the petty bourgeoisie. |  |
| <a id="IV.6.1"></a>**IV.6.1** | Sie unterläßt aber keinen Augenblick, bei den Arbeitern ein möglichst klares Bewußtsein über den feindlichen Gegensatz zwischen Bourgeoisie und Proletariat herauszuarbeiten, damit die deutschen Arbeiter sogleich die gesellschaftlichen und politischen Bedingungen, welche die Bourgeoisie mit ihrer Herrschaft herbeiführen muß, als ebenso viele Waffen gegen die Bourgeoisie kehren können, damit, nach dem Sturz der reaktionären Klassen in Deutschland, sofort der Kampf gegen die Bourgeoisie selbst beginnt. | But they never cease, for a single instant, to instil into the working class the clearest possible recognition of the hostile antagonism between bourgeoisie and proletariat, in order that the German workers may straightway use, as so many weapons against the bourgeoisie, the social and political conditions that the bourgeoisie must necessarily introduce along with its supremacy, and in order that, after the fall of the reactionary classes in Germany, the fight against the bourgeoisie itself may immediately begin. | But they never stop, for a single moment, working to instill into the working class the clearest possible recognition of the hostile antagonism between bourgeoisie and proletariat. They do this so that the German workers can immediately turn against the bourgeoisie, as so many weapons, the social and political conditions that the bourgeoisie must inevitably introduce along with its rule - and so that, after the fall of the reactionary classes in Germany, the fight against the bourgeoisie itself can immediately begin. |  |
| <a id="IV.7.1"></a>**IV.7.1** | Auf Deutschland richten die Kommunisten ihre Hauptaufmerksamkeit, weil Deutschland am Vorabend einer bürgerlichen Revolution steht und weil es diese Umwälzung unter fortgeschrittneren Bedingungen der europäischen Zivilisation überhaupt und mit einem viel weiter entwickelten Proletariat vollbringt als England im 17. und Frankreich im 18. Jahrhundert, die deutsche bürgerliche Revolution also nur das unmittelbare Vorspiel einer proletarischen Revolution sein kann. | The Communists turn their attention chiefly to Germany, because that country is on the eve of a bourgeois revolution that is bound to be carried out under more advanced conditions of European civilisation and with a much more developed proletariat than that of England was in the seventeenth, and France in the eighteenth century, and because the bourgeois revolution in Germany will be but the prelude to an immediately following proletarian revolution. | The communists focus chiefly on Germany, because that country is on the eve of a bourgeois revolution that is bound to be carried out under more advanced conditions of European civilization, and with a much more developed proletariat, than either the English revolution of the seventeenth century or the French revolution of the eighteenth. The bourgeois revolution in Germany will therefore be only the prelude to a proletarian revolution that immediately follows. |  |
| <a id="IV.8.1"></a>**IV.8.1** | Mit einem Wort, die Kommunisten unterstützen überall jede revolutionäre Bewegung gegen die bestehenden gesellschaftlichen und politischen Zustände. | In short, the Communists everywhere support every revolutionary movement against the existing social and political order of things. | In short, the communists everywhere support every revolutionary movement against the existing social and political order of things. |  |
| <a id="IV.9.1"></a>**IV.9.1** | In allen diesen Bewegungen heben sie die Eigentumsfrage, welche mehr oder minder entwickelte Form sie auch angenommen haben möge, als die Grundfrage der Bewegung hervor. | In all these movements, they bring to the front, as the leading question in each, the property question, no matter what its degree of development at the time. | In all these movements they bring to the front, as the leading question in each, the property question - no matter what degree of development it has reached at the time. |  |
| <a id="IV.10.1"></a>**IV.10.1** | Die Kommunisten arbeiten endlich überall an der Verbindung und Verständigung der demokratischen Parteien aller Länder. | Finally, they labour everywhere for the union and agreement of the democratic parties of all countries. | Finally, they work everywhere for the union and agreement of the democratic parties of all countries. |  |
| <a id="IV.11.1"></a>**IV.11.1** | Die Kommunisten verschmähen es, ihre Ansichten und Absichten zu verheimlichen. | The Communists disdain to conceal their views and aims. | The communists refuse to hide their views and aims. |  |
| <a id="IV.11.2"></a>**IV.11.2** | Sie erklären es offen, daß ihre Zwecke nur erreicht werden können durch den gewaltsamen Umsturz aller bisherigen Gesellschaftsordnung. | They openly declare that their ends can be attained only by the forcible overthrow of all existing social conditions. | They openly declare that their ends can only be reached by the forcible overthrow of all existing social conditions. |  |
| <a id="IV.11.3"></a>**IV.11.3** | Mögen die herrschenden Klassen vor einer kommunistischen Revolution zittern. | Let the ruling classes tremble at a Communistic revolution. | Let the ruling classes tremble at a communist revolution. |  |
| <a id="IV.11.4"></a>**IV.11.4** | Die Proletarier haben nichts in ihr zu verlieren als ihre Ketten. | The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. | The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. |  |
| <a id="IV.11.5"></a>**IV.11.5** | Sie haben eine Welt zu gewinnen. | They have a world to win. | They have a world to win. |  |
| <a id="IV.12.1"></a>**IV.12.1** | Proletarier aller Länder, vereinigt euch! | Working Men of All Countries, Unite! | WORKERS OF ALL COUNTRIES, UNITE! | 'Workers of the world, unite!' is the popular form and is in neither edition. See glossary. |
